construction_installation_page.hero_sub: LLC Energy Plus performs the full cycle of construction of gas and heat supply systems for municipal utilities, industrial and social facilities, including internal and external gas pipelines, boiler rooms, mini-CHPs, central heating substations, and individual heating stations.
construction_installation_page.scope_title: THE SCOPE OF CONSTRUCTION AND INSTALLATION WORKS (CIW) INCLUDES:
construction_installation_page.scope1: Preparation of statutory permits (building permits, excavation permits, contracts for construction, technical, and designer supervision, etc.)
construction_installation_page.scope2: Procurement and delivery of equipment and materials in full compliance with project specifications.
construction_installation_page.scope3: Installation of external and internal utility systems (thermo-mechanical, flue gas evacuation, heating, ventilation, water supply, sewage, power supply, automation, alarms) for power/heat generation plants.
construction_installation_page.scope4: Execution of pressure tests and commissioning works.
construction_installation_page.scope5: Preparation and approval of as-built documentation.
construction_installation_page.scope6: Formal facility handover and inspection approval before state supervisory bodies.
construction_installation_page.savings_desc: An integrated turnkey approach enables savings of up to 38% on total expenditure thanks to our partner programs with equipment manufacturers and suppliers, alongside streamlined cooperation protocols with state supervisory authorities, cutting commissioning lead times.
